fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the talk: `t` and eight hex digits of a hash of its event, title and type, with `-2`, `-3` for a repeated one.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The id of the event in the events file.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of the talk or recording: Keynote, Talk or Panel, as the programme calls it, or for a World Plone Day video what it is; lightning-talk sessions are not recorded.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the talk, as the programme or the recording gives it.

fields.name: speakers
fields.description: The ids of the speakers in the people register. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: organisations
fields.description: The ids of the organisations in the organisations register, for a talk that the source attributes to a team instead of people. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: location
fields.description: For a World Plone Day video: where the talk was given, as the old record named it.

fields.name: video
fields.description: The web address of the recording, when one exists; one link, a second part goes to the notes.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: The ids of the sources in the source register that support the row. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: cited_as
fields.description: The sources of the row in words, as the community page shows and links them: the web addresses of the sources in `sources`, with their labels and quotes, such as `https://…; Board: https://…`. A row from before the source register keeps its old source cell here verbatim.
